name: rinseops
description: RinseOps — Run your laundry business from one place.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @rinseops/shared" "npm run dev -w @rinseops/api" "npm run dev -w @rinseops/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @rinseops/api && npm run build -w @rinseops/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
